marketing.homeHeroSupport: A caring basic school in Afrancho — Nursery through JHS.
marketing.homeAboutTitle: Excellence in education is our essence
marketing.homeAboutBlurb: We serve families in our community with a child-friendly environment grounded in hard work, respect, and teamwork.
marketing.homeExploreBlurb: Learn how we teach, what’s happening this term, and how to join our community.
marketing.aboutHeroDescription: A basic school committed to educating and developing the young people entrusted to our care.
marketing.aboutStoryTitle: Rooted in our community, growing with every child
marketing.aboutStoryIntro: We serve families across our district with quality Nursery, Kindergarten, Primary, and Junior High education.
marketing.aboutStoryBody1: Excellence in education is our essence. We provide the resources for academic rigor alongside inquiry, creativity, and initiative — so every learner grows into a well-rounded young person.
marketing.aboutStoryBody2: Our campus community values hard work, mutual respect, and a child-friendly atmosphere. We welcome all who share our commitment to personal development, responsibility, and service.
marketing.mission: To provide quality, inclusive, and holistic basic education that meets the aspirations of our learners — raising a generation who are productive citizens of Ghana and the world.
marketing.vision: To be a leading basic school in our community, modelling care, academic strength, and character for every pupil we serve.

values.title: Hard work
values.text: Every pupil is encouraged to give their best in class and beyond.

values.title: Respect
values.text: We honour one another — pupils, teachers, and families alike.

values.title: Child-friendly care
values.text: A safe, welcoming environment where young learners can thrive.

values.title: Teamwork
values.text: Teachers, staff, and parents work together for each child's growth.

marketing.academicsHeroDescription: A Ghana Education Service–aligned programme that balances academic rigor with inquiry, creativity, and character.
marketing.academicsPathwaysBlurb: From Nursery through Junior High School, every stage builds confidently on the last.
marketing.academicsEssenceTitle: Excellence in education is our essence
marketing.academicsEssenceBody: Class exercises, continuous assessment, and end-of-term exams help us track growth. Subjects include English, Mathematics, Integrated Science, Social Studies, Asante Twi, RME, Creative Arts, and Computing.

stages.title: Nursery
stages.text: Play-based foundations in language, number sense, and social skills in a warm, guided setting.

stages.title: Kindergarten
stages.text: Ready-for-primary learning through stories, creative arts, outdoor play, and early literacy.

stages.title: Primary
stages.text: Strong literacy and numeracy, Our World Our People, Creative Arts, Computing, and Asante Twi.

stages.title: Junior High
stages.text: Integrated Science, Social Studies, Career Technology, and preparation toward BECE.

marketing.admissionsHeroDescription: Deciding on the right school is an important choice. We welcome new families into our community with open arms.
marketing.admissionsStepsBlurb: A clear pathway from first enquiry to first day of school.
admissionsSteps: Complete an online enquiry or visit the school office.
Submit the child's birth certificate and recent passport photograph.
Attend an assessment / interview as scheduled.
Receive an offer and complete fee payment to confirm the place.
admissionsDocs: Parent / guardian Ghana Card or ID
marketing.newsHeroDescription: Programmes, celebrations, and updates from our basic school community.

newsPosts.title: Welcome to the new academic year
newsPosts.excerpt: Pupils and teachers returned for First Term with orientation for new Nursery and KG families.

newsPosts.title: Inter-house sports day
newsPosts.excerpt: Campus came alive with races, football, and cheer as houses competed in friendly spirit.

newsPosts.title: Reading week celebration
newsPosts.excerpt: Primary and JHS pupils showcased story performances and a book parade across the school.

newsPosts.title: End-of-term awards & speech day
newsPosts.excerpt: Excellence, improvement, and service awards celebrated our learners before the Christmas break.

marketing.contactHeroDescription: Call the office, send a message, or schedule a campus tour — we would love to welcome you.
